real_learner_data.source: No real learner has ever used the system. All calibration, readiness, and pilot analyses across S106-S113 use synthetic learner profiles generated in scripts (analyze_calibration_S110.js, run_calibration_sample_S108.js, test_calibration.js). The may-learner-state.js STORAGE_KEY ('cmaMayLearnerState') persists learner data to browser localStorage but no browser session with a real learner has been recorded. The project is a development-stage exam simulator with 2,031 certified MCQ items and 400 certified case items but no production deployment or user-facing launch.

pilot_usage_logs.location: In-memory only: May.context._pilotUsageLog[] in may-core.js (L3040-3056). Capped at 200 entries. Populated by _logPilotUsage() which is called from _guardedSpeak() (L3104). NOT persisted to localStorage. No export files exist.

gate_logs.location: In-memory only: May.context._gateLog[] in may-core.js (L3134-3136). Capped at 50 entries. Populated programmatically by _guardedRecommend() during runtime recommendation gate checks. Accessible via _getGateLog() (L3157-3159). Cleared by _clearSafetyLogs() (L3164). NOT persisted to localStorage.

calibration_sessions.detail: may-learner-state.js _liveCalibrationEnabled defaults to false (L984). _liveCalibrationSessions is an empty array (L987). The only calibration data generated has been through synthetic scripts (analyze_calibration_S110.js with 5 profiles/29 topics, run_calibration_sample_S108.js with 4 profiles, test_calibration.js with test scenarios). No real learner has triggered a calibration snapshot via recordAttempt(). The S110 analysis explicitly states: 'Live calibration infrastructure... exists but has not yet collected real learner data — this analysis uses synthetic data to establish the planning framework.'

monitoring_gaps: NO persistence of pilot usage logs to localStorage or any durable store — _pilotUsageLog is in-memory only and lost on page unload
NO persistence of safety logs or gate logs to localStorage — both are in-memory only, capped at 50 entries
NO export mechanism for pilot/safety/gate logs — _getPilotUsageLog(), _getSafetyLog(), _getGateLog() exist but have no corresponding export/download facility
NO external telemetry endpoint — no fetch/post to an analytics server or monitoring backend
NO admin dashboard or monitoring panel for observing pilot outcomes in real time
NO error/exception telemetry — JavaScript console errors and unhandled rejections are not captured or reported
NO performance monitoring hooks — page load time, rendering time, API call latency are not measured
NO session recording or replay capability for debugging real-user issues
NO A/B testing or feature-flag infrastructure beyond the single isPilotEnvironment() boolean
NO real-user data for any threshold validation — all 12 readiness thresholds (now 11 after S111 stabilityHigh 80→75) calibrated against synthetic profiles only
NO browser localStorage export files exist in the repository — no dumps of any real or test browser sessions
NO CRM or user-identity integration — learnerId is auto-generated from Date.now() and tied only to a single browser's localStorage
liveCalibration throttling (5 min / 20 attempts) may be too coarse for detecting rapid degradation during intensive study sessions
_pilotUsageLog cap of 200 and safety/gate log cap of 50 are adequate for short pilot sessions but insufficient for multi-day or multi-learner analysis without export
No mechanism to correlate pilot usage data across learners (all data is single-browser, single-user by design)

what_exists: Pilot usage logging (_logPilotUsage, _getPilotUsageLog) — in-memory, structured, per-call logging of behavior/section/topic/QID/safety/gate outcomes
Safety logging (_guardedSpeak → _safetyLog) — in-memory, per-call safety validation with violations
Gate logging (_guardedRecommend → _gateLog) — in-memory, per-recommendation defect/cert gate results
Calibration snapshotting (_commitCalibrationSnapshot → _liveCalibrationSessions) — throttled, in-memory readiness snapshots
Calibration metrics (logReadinessMetrics → _calibrationMetrics) — in-memory, full band/distribution/boundary data
Calibration export (exportCalibrationData) — aggregates all learner data into a single exportable object
Recommendation logging (logRecommendation) — persisted to localStorage cmaMayLearnerState.recommendationLog, capped 200
Session persistence (SessionPersistence in app.js) — saves/loads exam sessions with checkpoints and journal
isPilotEnvironment() — dual-source gating (config flag + CMA_MAY_PILOT env var) for controlled rollout
what_is_missing: Persistent storage for pilot usage, safety, and gate logs
telemetry_assessment.verdict: The monitoring infrastructure has good in-memory collection hooks but zero persistence and zero external reporting. Adequate for a single-session pilot with manual inspection via browser console, but inadequate for a gated expansion involving multiple learners over multiple sessions without adding at minimum: (a) localStorage persistence for logs, (b) an export/download button, and (c) periodic calibration export capability.

evidence_limitations: Cannot verify that safety filters work correctly with real learner questions (all testing uses synthetic QuestionID clones of pack_a items)
Cannot verify that readiness bands match real CMA exam outcomes (no real exam results to correlate against)

Cannot verify that stabilityHigh 80→75 adjustment (S111) improves Ready classification for real learners — synthetic borderline profile showed 16 near-boundary topics, but real learner stability distributions are unknown
Cannot verify that tutoring safety filters avoid false positives with real learner language patterns (synthetic scenarios use crafted violation text like 'The correct answer is B')
Cannot verify that calibration throttling (5min/20attempts) captures meaningful change points in real study sessions
Cannot verify that recommendation gates (defect + certified) behave correctly when the full 117-entry defect manifest and 2,031 certified items are in play simultaneously
Cannot verify localStorage quota behavior with real multi-session data accumulation (current caps prevent overflow but may truncate useful data)

Cannot verify that isPilotEnvironment() dual-gating works correctly in all browser environments (env var check relies on Node.js process.env which is undefined in browser; the try/catch handles this but has never been tested in production)

Cannot verify that the tutoring pilot's dead-man switch (tutoringPilotEnabled=false by default) prevents all pilot behavior in a real deployment — only unit-tested, never integration-tested with actual browser load
Cannot assess real learner engagement, drop-off, or satisfaction with tutoring features — no analytics, no feedback collection, no NPS/survey mechanism
recommendation_rationale: The project has zero real learner data. All calibration, safety, and readiness validation is synthetic. The monitoring infrastructure is in-memory only with no persistence or external reporting. Before any gated expansion, the project needs: (1) at least one real pilot session with CMA_MAY_PILOT=1 to validate runtime behavior in a real browser; (2) localStorage persistence added for pilot usage, safety, and gate logs; (3) an export mechanism for calibration data and logs; (4) confirmation that thresholds calibrated on synthetic data produce reasonable classifications for real learners. The dual-gating (isPilotEnvironment returning false by default) is well-designed for safe piloting — a single user can be enabled without affecting others. Default-on would be irresponsible without any real-user validation.
